program.name: Body Tour
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: A longer tour of the body: one muscle group a day in a new format, then cardio or core.
program.about: A muscle group a day, never the same way twice, with time to do it properly. Chest, back, shoulders, arms, glutes, calves, legs, forearms, the upper back, single-leg work, the kettlebell and more each get their days in straight sets, supersets, a circuit or an EMOM, then a short Tabata or a core circuit. The same group never lands two days running. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Every day different · one muscle group a day, then a finisher
